svg.title: Pipeline parallelism bubble diagram
svg.desc: A timeline diagram showing 4 pipeline stages (racks) on the Y-axis and time on the X-axis. Three colored batches progress diagonally through the stages. Gray hatched regions at the start and end of the timeline represent idle bubble time where racks are waiting.
svg.text: In training: must finish batch before weight update. Bubbles can't be fully eliminated.
